sourceText:
Tomatoes and tuna pasta sauce
By: Gaila Perez
Published: Friday, April 17, 2015 - 11:47am

Ingredients




1 box of your favorite whole wheat spaghetti or pasta
2 cans of tuna in olive oil
2 garlic cloves, chopped
20 grape tomatoes, sliced in half
2 tablespoons of capers
2 tablespoons of parsley, chopped
2 tablespoons of chives, chopped
1 tablespoon of olive oil
10 kalamata olives, sliced into small pieces

Preparation

1 Open the canned tuna and drain the oil, keep one spoon full. 2 Boil some salted water on a pot, cook the pasta for 8 minutes for "al dente" pasta. When done, drain the liquid and add some butter or olive oil. 3 On a frying pan, add one tablespoon of the tuna oil and one tablespoon of olive oil. Add the garlic and the tomatoes cook for 3-5 minutes and then ad the tuna, olives, capers, chives and parsley. 4 Mix well and let cook for another 5 minutes. 5 Serve right away.

About

As you may already know my thing is soup (if you didn't know, Yes I am a confessed soup junkie) but my husband is another history. His thing is pasta! and any pasta, but whole wheat pasta. If you, as him, love whole wheat pasta, you may already know that the best whole wheat pasta is either spaghetti or penne, so far in our opinion at least, the other presentations tasted like cardboard, have a weird texture or had no taste so ever. We have also tasted some gluten free pasta and so far our favorite is the rice noodles.
